title: Comfort Colors Pickleball Gramps Shirt, Dinking Since Retirement, Funny Retirement Gift for Gramps from Grandkids
description:
He retired, bought a paddle, and hasn't been home since. A friendly pickleball shirt for the Gramps who dinks for a living.

Who it's for:
- A Gramps who lives at the pickleball courts
- Retirement and birthday gifts from the grandkids
- Father's Day and Christmas shopping

About the design:
Arched gold 'PICKLEBALL' over a big cream 'GRAMPS', with paddles and a ball, plus a lime 'Dinking since retirement' line.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Pickleball Gramps design with two paddles and the line Dinking since retirement on a forest green tee.
